instruction: Bookmark both currently open tabs to the bookmarks bar for easy access.

metadata.explanation: Variation requires bookmarking both tabs to the bookmarks bar. Uses existing is_expected_bookmarks metric with bookmark_bar_websites_urls type. The metric checks if both URLs are subsets of bookmark bar URLs. Slightly more complex than original (2 bookmarks vs 1) but same type of operation.
metadata.verification: The evaluator checks that both URLs (https://blog.eleuther.ai/rotary-embeddings/ and https://jalammar.github.io/illustrated-transformer/) are present in the bookmark bar using is_expected_bookmarks with type bookmark_bar_websites_urls. The function verifies set(urls).issubset(bookmark_bar_websites_urls).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses get_bookmarks getter to read Chrome bookmarks file from filesystem
Metric is_expected_bookmarks with type 'bookmark_bar_websites_urls' correctly extracts bookmark bar URLs and compares using set equality
Expected values match the instruction: both URLs that were opened in tabs should be bookmarked
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome (pkill + relaunch + sleep) to ensure bookmarks are flushed to disk before verification
Complete coverage: instruction requires bookmarking 2 tabs, evaluator checks for exactly those 2 URLs
Set comparison logic correctly ignores order and checks for exact URL match
